title: Camden Settlement
summary: A Philadelphia survivor settlement in Extremis Malis whose conflict with the Founders gives Caleb Dunne and Heather Ward their local lead.

claims.text: The graphic novel uses the Camden settlement as the community pressured by the Founders' armed demands in Philadelphia.
Heather Ward and Caleb Dunne use the settlement's conflict to trace the Founders' connection to Mantis's weapons operation.

paragraphs.text: Camden is the point where a community-level protection problem becomes evidence of the wider arms network. It is recorded as a source-specific settlement, not as real-world visitor or safety information.

verification.notes: Fictional-use location record from the licensed graphic novel.
